author: Kruggsmash
description:
*An edited, illustrated, modded and narrated playthrough of the game Dwarf Fortress*

Welcome all to Yellowbells- a bountiful span of woodland tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Today we'll be building homes, making friends and enjoying the bounty of The Kingdom of Autumn!
